components.name: Inline text link
components.description: Default in-app and external link styling via `Link` component.
components.css: a.ds-text-link { color: #03B0EE; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms ease; } a.ds-text-link:hover, a.ds-text-link:focus { color: #4CAF50; outline: none; } a.ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #03B0EE; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter chip
components.description: Projects list filter; indigo on pale wash, pill shape.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 2rem; padding: 0.125rem 1rem; border-radius: 1rem; font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.7rem; color: #3F51B5; background: #E8EAF6; }

components.name: Text field (contact)
components.description: Bordered field with link-colored ring in valid state; 16px radius; max width 25rem on larger breakpoints.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 25rem; margin-top: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 2rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; color: #212121; background: #FAFAFA; border: 2px solid #03B0EE; border-radius: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); outline: none; caret-color: #4CAF50; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #4CAF50; }

components.name: Send message button
components.description: Full pill, cyan border, shimmer on hover, icon slot for send.
components.css: .ds-btn-send { display: flex; align-items: center; margin: 2rem auto; padding: 1rem 3rem; font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; background: #FAFAFA; color: #03B0EE; border: 2px solid #03B0EE; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); cursor: pointer; transition: color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-send:hover, .ds-btn-send:focus { color: #4CAF50; border-color: #4CAF50; } .ds-btn-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4CAF50; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Project image card
components.description: Linked tile: image, white seam border, large drop shadow, dark caption strip.
components.html: 1 Jan 2020
components.css: a.ds-card { display: block; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 1rem; border: 2px solid #ffffff; filter: drop-shadow(0 10px 15px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)) drop-shadow(0 4px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)); text-decoration: none; } .ds-card__image { min-height: 8rem; background: #DADADA; } .ds-card__bar { padding: 1rem; background: #424242; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 700; font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; } a.ds-card:hover .ds-card__bar, a.ds-card:focus .ds-card__bar { filter: brightness(1.25); }

components.name: GitHub / Live CTA
components.description: Small outlined action next to project description.
components.css: a.ds-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; margin: 0.5rem 0.5rem 0.5rem 0; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 2px solid #03B0EE; border-radius: 8px; background: #FAFAFA; color: #03B0EE; font-family: Lato, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } a.ds-cta:hover, a.ds-cta:focus { color: #4CAF50; border-color: #4CAF50; }

narrative.overview: The interface reads as a well-lit workbench: a paper-like field (#FAFAFA), high-contrast body text, and a single cool path for interactivity: cyan links that warm to green on hover or success. The surface is a personal proof-of-work site, not a product dashboard, so visuals defer to project media and long-form case content. The layout is container-centered with responsive padding steps. Readability is enforced with max-w-reading and max-w-field. Motion is local and functional. Nothing competes with scanning.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained neutrals, one link accent family, indigo only for filter chips and tags.
Merriweather for project and page titles; Lato for UI and body.
Flat or lightly lifted surfaces: default shadow on form fields, stronger drop-shadow-lg on project image cards, header drop-shadow on section chrome where defined.

rules.name: The one cool family rule
rules.body: Cyan and green own interactive feedback; do not add extra saturated hues for “decoration” on the same screen.

rules.name: The indigo is for tags rule
rules.body: Full-strength indigo and its 10% wash are reserved for chips and tags, not primary CTAs, so filters stay scannable and links stay the action color.

rules.name: The long-measure rule
rules.body: Keep paragraphs in max-w-reading on wide viewports. Do not stretch body copy to full 1280px width.

rules.name: The flat-caption rule
rules.body: Project card metadata is a full-width band, not a nested card with a second box shadow.

dos: Do keep the canvas in the off-white / grey-ink system and one link accent path for interactivity.
Do use project-title and project-subtitle (Merriweather) for case-study and page heroes.
Do keep chips indigo and links cyan/green so “filter” and “go” are visually distinct.
Do preserve max-w-reading and max-w-field for long copy and the contact form.
donts: Don't produce a generic "AI portfolio" or template lookalike with identical card grids, meaningless hero metrics, or decorative gradients; prefer varied project presentation and real content hierarchy.
Don't use dark mode for cool alone or neon-on-black tech clichés without a concrete scene and user need that justify them.
Don't ship dense walls of unbroken text or unreadable case studies; break with spacing, subheads, and line length.
Don't reach for a modal or heavy chrome where inline or a dedicated route is enough.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient) or glassmorphism as a default.
Don't use a colored left or right border strip (thick accent border-left / border-right on list rows or callouts) as the primary affordance; use full borders, tints, or typography.
Don't stack card inside card for the same content tier.
